application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with new side window on the ground floor with photovoltaic/solar panels on the rear outrigger roof and on rear dormer roof (AMENDED DESCRIPTION)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning statement, 10183A01001, 10183A03001, 10183A05001 Received: 04/05/2021; 10183A05002-A, 10183A03002-A Received: 23/06/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Once the solar PV or solar equipment hereby permitted has reached the end of their lifetime they should be removed as soon as reasonably practicable.
